description: Start the one sign-in that lets Chockstone Labs read and answer a connected TikTok account's comments (TikTok API for Business). Returns a link for the signed-in owner to open and approve on TikTok; the sign-in is saved on the same account, and posting is unchanged. TikTok allows this only on Business accounts (switching is free in TikTok's settings). accounts_list comments says where each TikTok account stands. The link works once, for 15 minutes, and only for the person it was made for.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

return_to.description: app: the signed-in iPhone app's own sign-in sheet. TikTok hands back to the app, which finishes with tiktok_comments_finish.

name: tiktok_comments_connect
title: Answer TikTok comments here
